tspan.tspan: India’s inflation fell to 0.25% in October 2025, the lowest on record
Year‐on‐year change in consumer prices, every month from January 2014 to December 2025,
coloured by where it sits against the Reserve Bank’s target band of 2% to 6%.
Source: MOSPI (CPI, base 2012, All‐India combined); RBI
